pages.text: Craft a $(l)Town Charter$() and place it where your town's centre should be. That founds a settlement and you become its ruler.$(br2)Your $(l)first town is your kingdom's capital$(). The charter comes with what the first Town Hall needs, food for the first days, and you receive $(l)Architect's Plans$().

Towns need room: a charter is refused inside or too close to another town.$(br2)Placing another charter inside your own town moves its seat of government there.$(br2)Right-click the charter at any time to open the $(l)City Manager$().
